title: Indirect questions 2
note: Embedded statement order after tell me / know / wonder. · Bank 8 · order-zone gaps 2026-07-26 · Match off 2026-07-26 · dressed 8→24 items 2026-08-16 (Patrik: "ask him when is he") · 2026-08-19: item 17 duplicated item 2 ('how much it costs') — replaced

items.en: Can you tell me where the station is?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kde je nádraží?
items.gap: Can you tell me where ____? (station / be)
accepts: Can you tell me where the station is?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?

items.en: Do you know what time the train leaves?
items.cz: Víš, v kolik odjíždí vlak?
items.gap: Do you know what time ____ (train / leave)?
accepts: Do you know what time the train leaves?
Do you know what time the train will leave?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Do you know what time does the train leave?

items.en: Could you tell me how much it costs?
items.cz: Mohl bys mi říct, kolik to stojí?
items.gap: Could you tell me how much ____ (it / cost)?
accepts: Could you tell me how much it costs?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Could you tell me how much does it cost?

items.en: Can you tell me whether the shop is open?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, jestli je obchod otevřený?
items.gap: Can you tell me whether ____ open? (shop / be)
accepts: Can you tell me whether the shop is open?
Can you tell me if the shop is open?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Can you tell me whether is the shop open?

items.en: I wonder when the meeting starts.
items.cz: Zajímalo by mě, kdy schůzka začíná.
items.gap: I wonder when ____ (meeting / start).
accepts: I wonder when the meeting starts.
I wonder when the meeting will start.
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: I wonder when does the meeting start.

items.en: Could you tell me where the toilets are?
items.cz: Mohl bys mi říct, kde jsou toalety?
items.gap: Could you tell me where ____? (toilets / be)
accepts: Could you tell me where the toilets are?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Could you tell me where are the toilets?

items.en: Do you know if she has a car?
items.cz: Víš, jestli má auto?
items.gap: Do you know if ____ a car? (she / have)
accepts: Do you know if she has a car?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Do you know if does she have a car?

items.en: Can you tell me why he was late?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, proč měl zpoždění?
items.gap: Can you tell me why ____ late? (he)
accepts: Can you tell me why he was late?
Can you tell me why he is late?
Can you tell me why he's late?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Can you tell me why was he late?

items.en: Do you know when the meeting starts?
items.cz: Víš, kdy začíná ta schůzka?
items.gap: Do you know when ____? (meeting / start)
accepts: Do you know when the meeting starts?
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: Do you know when does the meeting start?

items.en: Can you tell me where he works?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kde pracuje?
items.gap: Can you tell me where ____? (he / work)
accepts: Can you tell me where he works?
Can you tell me where she works?
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: Can you tell me where does he work?

items.en: Ask him when he is coming.
items.cz: Zeptej se ho, kdy přijde.
items.gap: Ask him when ____. (he / coming)
accepts: Ask him when he is coming.
Ask him when he's coming.
Ask him when he comes.
Ask him when he will come.
Ask him when he'll come.
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Ask him when is he coming.

items.en: I wonder how it is in other countries.
items.cz: Zajímalo by mě, jak to je v jiných zemích.
items.gap: I wonder how ____ in other countries. (it / be)
accepts: I wonder how it is in other countries.
I wonder how it's in other countries.
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: I wonder how is it in other countries.

items.en: Do you know if the shop is open?
items.cz: Víš, jestli je ten obchod otevřený?
items.gap: Do you know ____ open? (shop)
accepts: Do you know if the shop is open?
items.explanation: A yes/no question embeds with if or whether.
items.explanation_cz: Zjišťovací otázka se uvozuje pomocí if nebo whether.
items.wrong: Do you know if is the shop open?

items.en: Could you tell me what time it starts?
items.cz: Můžete mi říct, v kolik to začíná?
items.gap: Could you tell me ____? (time / start)
accepts: Could you tell me what time it starts?
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: Could you tell me what time does it start?

items.en: I do not know why she left.
items.cz: Nevím, proč odešla.
items.gap: I do not know why ____. (she / leave)
accepts: I do not know why she left.
I don't know why she left.
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: I do not know why did she leave.

items.en: I am not sure whether he got the email.
items.cz: Nejsem si jistý, jestli ten e-mail dostal.
items.gap: I am not sure whether ____ the email. (he / get)
accepts: I am not sure whether he got the email.
I'm not sure whether he got the email.
items.explanation: A yes/no question embeds with if or whether.
items.explanation_cz: Zjišťovací otázka se uvozuje pomocí if nebo whether.
items.wrong: I am not sure whether did he get the email.

items.en: Do you have any idea where the office is?
items.cz: Máš tušení, kde je ta kancelář?
items.gap: Do you have any idea where ____? (office / be)
accepts: Do you have any idea where the office is?
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: Do you have any idea where is the office?

items.en: Could you tell me how this machine works?
items.cz: Mohl byste mi říct, jak tenhle stroj funguje?
items.gap: Could you tell me how ____? (this machine / work)
accepts: Could you tell me how this machine works?
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: Could you tell me how does this machine work?

items.en: I would like to know who is responsible.
items.cz: Chtěl bych vědět, kdo je zodpovědný.
items.gap: I would like to know ____ responsible. (who / be)
accepts: I would like to know who is responsible.
items.explanation: When who/what IS the subject, the order does not change: who is responsible.
items.explanation_cz: Když je who/what podmětem, pořadí se nemění: who is responsible.

items.en: Do you know what he wants?
items.cz: Víš, co chce?
items.gap: Do you know what ____? (he / want)
accepts: Do you know what he wants?
Do you know what she wants?
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: Do you know what does he want?

items.en: Ask her where she put the keys.
items.cz: Zeptej se jí, kam dala klíče.
items.gap: Ask her where ____ the keys. (she / put)
accepts: Ask her where she put the keys.
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: Ask her where did she put the keys.

items.en: I wonder if they will accept the offer.
items.cz: Zajímalo by mě, jestli tu nabídku přijmou.
items.gap: I wonder if ____ the offer. (they / accept)
accepts: I wonder if they will accept the offer.
I wonder if they'll accept the offer.
items.explanation: Unlike an if-conditional, an embedded question keeps will: I wonder if they will accept.
items.explanation_cz: Na rozdíl od podmínky si vložená otázka will nechává: I wonder if they will accept.
items.wrong: I wonder if will they accept the offer.

items.en: Can you tell me when the next train leaves?
items.cz: Můžeš mi říct, kdy jede další vlak?
items.gap: Can you tell me when ____? (next train / leave)
accepts: Can you tell me when the next train leaves?
items.explanation: The do/does/did of the direct question disappears — the verb carries the ending instead.
items.explanation_cz: Pomocné do/does/did z přímé otázky mizí — koncovku nese samotné sloveso.
items.wrong: Can you tell me when does the next train leave?

items.en: No one knows what the plan is.
items.cz: Nikdo neví, jaký je plán.
items.gap: No one knows what ____. (plan / be)
accepts: No one knows what the plan is.
items.explanation: After the question phrase: subject + verb (statement order).
items.explanation_cz: Po úvodu otázky: podmět + sloveso (pořadí jako ve větě).
items.wrong: No one knows what is the plan.

cards.title: Direct questions
points: Question form: the helper (**do** / **be**) before the subject.

cards.title: Indirect questions
points: Still questions. They do **not** use question form.
After the frame: subject + verb (no helper).

rows: Can you tell me where the station **is**?
Can you tell me where he **works**?
Do you know if the shop **is** open?

cards.title: do / does / did disappear

rows: Do you know where he lives?

points: The verb takes its normal ending

cards.title: Yes–no questions → if / whether

rows: Do you know if it is open?

points: Yes/no → if or whether + statement order

rows: Can you tell me where is the station? ✗
Can you tell me what time does the train leave? ✗

points: Type the inside part in statement order
